products.name: blueMonster
products.one_liner: blueMonster lite: the idea-discovery engine for Mac with MBR export, pool sharing, and signed receipt-backed runs.
products.audience: Anyone with a hard question who wants a wide, evidenced search of the space

products.name: blueGlu
products.one_liner: blueGlu gives you a capable AI assistant that runs entirely on your own phone, laptop, and tablet — your data never leaves your devices — and, when you want more power, quietly pools your own idle machines into a private mesh instead of sending anything to a cloud.
products.audience: Consumers who want a capable private AI assistant across their own devices
products.not_this: blueGlu does not claim to beat frontier cloud models on raw capability — it offers something cloud AI cannot offer at all: capable inference that never leaves your devices.

products.name: blueAlibi
products.one_liner: Find claims the recorded evidence and tools could not support.
products.audience: IP counsel, diligence teams, and anyone auditing an AI-drafted document for unsupported claims
products.not_this: not a global fact checker, not a legal or regulatory opinion, and provenance support does not prove a claim is true. A signed receipt proves what this software ran and recorded — nothing more.

products.name: blueFloor
products.one_liner: Measure the ingest your deployed detections can actually use.
products.not_this: blueFloor does not author detections or judge whether a rule is good.

products.name: blueIntent
products.one_liner: Check whether declared code invariants survived a change.
products.audience: Engineering and security teams reviewing AI-authored code changes
products.not_this: This is not formal verification, not a claim of full semantic preservation, and not autonomous code repair.

products.name: blueParity
products.one_liner: Prove a replacement system stays equivalent within a declared contract.
products.not_this: Equivalence is not correctness. A signed receipt proves what this software ran and recorded; it does not prove either system, or any underlying real-world claim, is correct.

products.name: bluePipeline
products.one_liner: See what actually reached the model.
products.audience: ML/LLM engineering teams debugging prompt and config drift
products.not_this: This is not a general LLM observability platform, a model-quality scorer, or an auto-repair tool.

products.name: blueMonster Premium
products.one_liner: Private-preview cloud research workbench. Turns a broad research objective into a sealed, budgeted plan, runs a durable multi-stage research engine, and produces an evidence-ranked board of survivors, business hypotheses, and explicit refusals.
products.audience: Teams that want a deeper, budgeted research run than the free desktop app
products.not_this: This is an independent product. It does not import from, deploy into, or share any database/queue/secret/virtual-environment with blueMonster Pro, blueHelm, blueCloud, slumberNet, or any other MOBLUEHQ product, and it keeps working if all of them are offline or deleted.

products.name: blueGrant
products.one_liner: blueGrant Global continuously discovers grant and prize opportunities worldwide from official sources only, scores each on whether we can win it and deliver it, then puts the blueMonster engine to work drafting the application — with a human approving every submission and a compliance gate checking every claim against the funder's own pinned rules text.
products.not_this: Receipts prove process, not truth. blueGrant records what was searched, what was scored and why, and what evidence each drafted claim rests on. It does not assert that any application will win.

products.name: blueMoat
products.one_liner: Verifiable IDS diligence workflow for patent prosecution attorneys.
products.audience: Patent prosecution attorneys and IP diligence teams
products.not_this: blueMoat outputs are draft diligence artifacts for attorney review — not legal opinions, clearance, or filing recommendations.

products.name: blueLegal
products.one_liner: One suite for the legal profession, built on one grounded-evidence engine.
products.audience: Patent practices, IP counsel, and legal ops teams
products.not_this: A signed receipt proves what this software ran and recorded against which documents; it does not prove an underlying legal conclusion is correct. No blueLegal product renders a legal opinion, files, advises, or decides.

products.name: Blue
products.one_liner: The verification substrate every MOBLUEHQ product runs on. A private inference mesh that returns sealed, signed results — the scheduler never sees your data, and every answer carries a receipt anyone can verify.
products.audience: Anyone building AI into decisions that carry consequences

products.name: slumberNet
products.one_liner: Donate your computer's idle time to the mesh. Install it, and when you're away your machine quietly helps run verified AI work — then gets out of the way the instant you return.
products.audience: Anyone with a capable machine and idle hours

products.name: blueChart
products.description: Evidence packs for utilization review - criteria cited, sources quoted verbatim, dissent shown, every pack signed and offline-verifiable. No autonomous denials, by architecture. Private demo available on request. For health plans and utilization-review teams - speed on medical review without the liability of an unexplained denial.
